decisions.summary: intro-check's bundle holds only the research page's heading, intro, opening paragraph and lead lines, the drawing page's heading and opening, and modal Name/Label; NEEDS-INTRO names 'the drawing page's class' from attested/deviation/convention
decisions.why: FR-001 and the intro Edge Case require the check to verify the intro adds no historical claim the CITED BODY does not carry, and to name the class 'the question's cited body or drawing page' reaches, including 'an invention of the setting'. A bundle without the cited body cannot do the INTRO-FIX half it is for (spec item 6: the mechanism cannot reach its stated purpose), and sourcing the class from the drawing page alone drops half of FR-001. Fix: the bundle carries the research page's visible body (comments stripped), and the class list and source match FR-001.

decisions.why: FR-006 and the spec's decision that answer records live in the pushing clone.

decisions.summary: Without BUNDLE=, record-checked records the tree's CURRENT fingerprints, for source-reader and 'for fixes that apply the check's own findings', with no reason required or logged
decisions.why: FR-006: the record carries 'the content the check read' and is stale once it changes; FR-007: the only other discharge is a stated reason written to the bypass log. Recording content the check never read after a fix is an unlogged discharge open to any check at any time, and contradicts FR-008's 'each written intro passes the check in at most two rounds'. Not impossible, not implied by the request. Fix: without BUNDLE= the record requires a stated reason (two words or more) written to the bypass log, or is limited to source-reader on a note whose source it read; a fix that applies findings is re-checked (within the two-round cap) or discharged by a logged reason.

decisions.summary: check-bundle refuses a not-owed FOR= bundle (NOT_OWED_OK reason, logged), owed-notes default for quote-check, MANIFEST owed lines, dispatch hook refusing a check the MANIFEST does not owe (CHECK_NOT_OWED_OK)
decisions.why: FR-005 and US2 ('builds no bundle and dispatches no check that is not owed'); enforcement of the requested behavior.

decisions.summary: record-style exempt from the not-owed refusal
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions: record-style stays a sweep check owed by a declared sweep (feature 292), outside the owed table.

decisions.summary: source-reader wholly exempt from the bundle refusal and the dispatch hook
decisions.why: FR-004 owes source-reader on a new or changed note and FR-005 refuses a not-owed bundle. The pre-note research read is a real case where nothing is owed yet, but the wholesale exemption also lets a session re-run source-reader over every existing note for a formatting sweep - the GM's named fear ('whether the research accurately characterizes its source ... for all 2,000 something'). Adjudicated separately from the pre-note case: exempting only a read for a note not yet in the record (e.g. a KEY= bundle for a source no existing note cites, or the new note's id absent at the base and in the tree) would be legitimate; the blanket exemption is not.

decisions.summary: A KEY= bundle is never refused (source-reader and source-applicability)
decisions.why: FR-004 owes source-applicability on a write-up whose visible text changed, so a KEY= bundle on an unchanged source is not owed and FR-005 refuses it. The exemption reopens exactly the whole-source re-run the GM worried about. Its one non-delta occasion (before a source's numbers reach a map or rule, kept on the task box by the spec's Assumptions) is served by NOT_OWED_OK with a stated reason, so the exemption is not necessary.
